Guide the full icon design process for our app using the attached brand references and seven colors
expected_behavior: extracts product purpose, audience, visual traits, and palette from supplied references before choosing concepts
routes through icon-brief, icon-draw, icon-critique, and icon-export in order, skipping only stages the user does not need
treats seven colors as valid and never reduces the palette to three by default
passes the same approved design direction and palette through each stage without re-ideating during drawing
stops at critique for human candidate selection and requires an approved master before export

cases.prompt: I only need concepts for a new icon; guide me to the right skill
expected_behavior: routes to icon-brief only and explains the next optional step
does not create SVGs or export files
uses product and brand context to shape the brief

cases.prompt: Our brand guide says vivid, layered gradients and asymmetry; make an icon through this pipeline
expected_behavior: treats the supplied brand direction as the design source of truth instead of imposing dark grey, symmetry, or a three-color cap
identifies current SVG safe-subset limits that conflict with requested effects and reports them clearly
offers a faithful supported interpretation or asks the user to choose before discarding required brand traits

cases.prompt: The icon is approved; export web, Apple, and Android assets
expected_behavior: routes directly to icon-export when an approved master exists
does not rerun concepting, drawing, or critique without need
